items.title: Rogers gepresenteerd door Chelsea: 'Dit is de grootste club van Londen'
items.summary: De meeste transferwindows zijn geopend en dus neemt het transfernieuws weer toe. Traditiegetrouw volgt Voetbal International de buitenlandse markt op de voet. Bekijk hier ons blog voor de transferperikelen in Nederland.

items.title: Chelsea sign £117m Rogers - what will he bring?
items.summary: Chelsea's £117m move for Aston Villa midfielder Morgan Rogers is a genuine transfer window shock - so how did they do it and what does it mean for the rest of the squad?

items.title: 135 miljoen euro: Chelsea rondt recordtransfer Engels international Rogers af
items.summary: Chelsea heeft de komst van Morgan Rogers officieel gemaakt. De Engels international is voor naar verluidt liefst 135 miljoen euro overgenomen van Aston Villa. Daarmee is Rogers de duurste aankoop uit de clubgeschiedenis van Chelsea.

items.title: Iraola vertelt wanneer Van Dijk, Gakpo en Gravenberch zich moeten melden
items.summary: Cody Gakpo en Virgil van Dijk reizen niet met de selectie van Liverpool naar de Verenigde Staten. Ryan Gravenberch zal wel aanwezig zijn op het trainingskamp.

items.title: Curaçaose bondsvoorzitter Martina stopt vanwege gezondheidsproblemen
items.summary: Bondsvoorzitter van Curaçao, Gilbert Martina, stapt per direct op. De voetbalbond maakte bekend dat Martina zijn functie naast zich neerlegt vanwege gezondheidsredenen.

items.title: Liverpool owner FSG in talks to sell 30% stake to Amit Bhatia consortium for £1.35bn
items.summary: Bhatia resigns as a director of QPR Minority stake deal values the club at £4.5bn Liverpool’s owner is in talks over ­selling a minority stake to a consortium led by the former Queens Park Rangers co‑owner Amit ­Bhatia and backed by his father-in-law ­Lakshmi Mittal, the billionaire Indian steel magnate. The Guardian understands a sale of 30% of the club is being discussed, with an offer of around £1.35bn on the table. Fenway Sports Group confirmed in a statement to the Financial Times that it had begun negotiations with a group led by Bhatia over a ­potential minority share sale that would value ­Liverpool at about £4.5bn. Continue reading...

items.title: Fenerbahçe zet eerste stap richting Champions League, FC Twente kijkt mee
items.summary: Fenerbahçe is de jacht op een Champions League-ticket goed begonnen. De topclub uit Turkije won de eerste van twee wedstrijden van het Poolse Górnik Zabrze. De uitslag van het tweeluik is relevant voor FC Twente.

items.title: Could the World Cup be back in the US as soon as 2038? Absolutely
items.summary: Explosion in ticketing and hospitality revenue goes along with a Fifa desire to recoup lost TV income in future deals As is often the case, it has been left to Donald Trump to say the quiet bit out loud. “We have to do this again and we have to do it while I’m around, you hear that Gianni?” the US president told Fox News in an interview broadcast in the buildup to the World Cup final. An American bid for the 2038 World Cup has been the talk of the hotel lobbies populated by administrators from around the world over the past month, who have watched this country’s seemingly limitless appetite for major events and willingness to pay whatever it takes to attend them. Continue reading...

items.title: Old Firm disorder report damning - how will authorities respond?
items.summary: It took four months to land but, when it did, the independent review of crowd disorder at the Old Firm Scottish Cup quarter-final at Ibrox in March arrived with a mighty thud, writes Tom English.

items.title: Manchester United supporters groups in uproar over suspension of season tickets
items.summary: Fans claim they are being ‘treated as suspects’ Club planning to reinstate tickets before season begins Manchester United’s official Fans’ Forum, Manchester United Suppor­ters Trust (Must), The 1958 and five other such groups have complained to the club over supporters being “treated as suspects” after some had season tickets suspended as part of a move to stop the illegal reselling of seats. United last week contacted fans who used six or more devices to access accounts linked to the club or to forward tickets, as in their view this suggested the potential buying of seats to resell. Members are allowed only to forward tickets to other members, or sell them back to United. Continue reading...

items.title: Consortium in talks to buy Liverpool minority stake
items.summary: A consortium led by British-Indian millionaire businessman Amit Bhatia expresses an interest in buying a minority stake in Liverpool.

items.title: Al-Hilal agree £60m deal for West Ham's Summerville
items.summary: Saudi club Al Hilal agree a £68.3m deal to sign winger Crysencio Summerville from West Ham.

items.title: ‘The scrutiny is constant’: referee Anthony Taylor retires from football
items.summary: The 47-year-old took charge of five World Cup matches Taylor has refereed in the Premier League for 16 years Anthony Taylor has announced his retirement from elite refereeing after a distinguished career spanning more than two decades and 831 matches. One of England’s most accomplished officials, the 47-year-old officiated 668 matches in the professional game in England. He brings the curtain down on his career following his final appointment – the World Cup last‑16 game between Portugal and Spain in the US. Continue reading...

items.title: Fernandez defends Argentina as Messi questions remain
items.summary: Midfielder Enzo Fernandez claims Argentina represented their nation "in the best possible way" in the World Cup.

items.title: ‘The utmost respect for him’: Alex Ferguson pays tribute to Kevin Keegan
items.summary: Ferguson says Keegan’s Newcastle was their best team ‘Kevin carried the love of the game on his sleeve’ Sir Alex Ferguson has saluted Kevin Keegan for building Newcastle’s “greatest team”. Keegan, who had cancer, died on Monday at the age of 75 and Ferguson has joined the tributes for one of football’s most endearing characters. Ferguson and Keegan were involved a fierce battle for Premier League supremacy, with Ferguson’s Manchester United pipping Newcastle to the title in 1996. “I had the utmost respect for him,” Ferguson told Track Radio. “We had many duels when he was manager of Newcastle, but the job he did at Newcastle was fantastic. He re-energised that club and he brought that enthusiasm and fanaticism great supporters can give. Continue reading...

items.title: DONE DEAL: Sporting Hasselt toont ambitie met versterking van Essevee (ex-Anderlecht)
items.summary: Sporting Hasselt haalt stevig uit. Het heeft Siebe Van Keymolen weten weg te plukken bij Zulte Waregem. De man zal voor doelpunten moeten gaan zorgen in de Challenger Pro League bij de Limburgers.

items.title: Les dernières rumeurs, les officialisations : suivez le mercato en direct ! 21/07: Descotte - Cozier-Duberry
items.summary: Toutes les rumeurs de transfert, toutes les officialisations regroupées en un seul article. On vous dit tout sur le mercato en Jupiler Pro League, en Challenger Pro League et sur celui des Diables Rouges... en direct !

items.title: C'est signé : un départ dans le secteur offensif à Charleroi
items.summary: Cet été, Anthony Descotte a une nouvelle fois fait son retour à Charleroi. Il ne restera toutefois pas Zèbre dans les prochains mois : la direction a décidé de le prêter une troisième fois.

items.title: Un restau annulé qui coûte cher, Witsel presque adjoint : les langues se délient sur Rudi Garcia
items.summary: Malgré une Coupe du monde réussie et des objectifs atteints, l'Union Belge a décidé de ne pas prolonger le contrat de Rudi Garcia. Une fin de collaboration qui semble arranger les deux parties après quelques moments de crispation.

items.title: 'Vertrek van Club Brugge komt er snel aan: deal nakend'
items.summary: De interesse in Raphael Onyedika is groter dan ooit. Club Brugge hoopt ook voor hem een heel mooi transferbedrag te vangen, terwijl duidelijk is dat ze hem deze zomer mogelijk zullen laten gaan en daar ook afspraken zijn over gemaakt.

items.title: Officiel : libéré par le Standard, Teddy Teuma a retrouvé un club dans une destination inattendue
items.summary: Teddy Teuma se cherchait un nouveau club depuis la fin de son aventure au Standard. Il a retrouvé chaussure à son pied à Malte, dont il défend les couleurs en sélection depuis maintenant plusieurs années.

items.title: Transfernieuws en Transfergeruchten 21/07: Appiah - Verstraete - Bisiwu - Campbell - Kuavita
items.summary: De transfergeruchten, het laatste transfernieuws en officiële transfers vliegen ons om de oren. Bij Voetbalkrant zetten wij alles voor u op een rijtje zodat u tijdens deze mercato niets hoeft te missen! Op 21/07 hebben we transfernieuws en transfergeruchten voor u over:

items.title: Ooit voor miljoenen naar Anderlecht, nu bij de club van ... Kylian Mbappé
items.summary: Anderlecht nam Dennis Appiah tien jaar geleden voor drie miljoen euro over van Caen. Vandaag keert de Franse flankverdediger terug naar de club die zijn profcarrière lanceerde. Maar de omgeving van het Stade Malherbe is intussen grondig veranderd.

items.title: KAA Gent schrikt zich een hoedje in Zweden
items.summary: KAA Gent was vanavond meer dan waarschijnlijk aanwezig in Göteborg. Dat om een belangrijk duel in de gaten te houden met oog op hun persoonlijke toekomst. Mogelijk hebben ze zich ook enigszins verslikt in hun koffie, want Levadia Tallinn pakte uit met een stunt aldaar.

items.title: Qui ne tente rien n'a rien : Anderlecht recalé pour un ancien grand espoir d'Arsenal
items.summary: Anderlecht a tenté de faire venir Amario Cozier-Duberry au Lotto Park, mais Brighton a rejeté la proposition. Les Mauves auraient discuté d’un package de près de six millions d'euros pour l’ailier droit de 21 ans.

items.title: Enzo Fernandez: Argentina played with 'pride' and 'humility'
items.summary: Enzo Fernandez has praised Argentina for playing with "pride" and "humility" at the 2026 World Cup after it was confirmed FIFA will investigate the team's behaviour after the final.

items.title: Curran, Pooran blast defending champs MI London past SunRisers in Hundred opener
items.summary: MI London began their quest for a fourth successive Hundred title with a seven-wicket victory over SunRisers Leeds at The Kia Oval that raised the curtain on the new-look competition.

items.title: Broad: England Test job less attractive than it was
items.summary: Former England bowler Stuart Broad says he understands Andy Flower's decision to turn down the England Test job, and is unsure over who the ECB turn to next, pondering whether the role has become "less attractive".

items.title: Stokes scores century in first match for Durham after England retirement
items.summary: Former England captain Ben Stokes hit a match-winning hundred in his first appearance for Durham following his international retirement.
